an8.36:1.3: dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu.
an8.36:2.1: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu parittaṃ kataṃ hoti bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:2.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā manussadobhaggaṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:3.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā manussasobhaggaṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:4.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:4.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:4.3: tatra bhikkhave, cattāro mahārājāno dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā cātummahārājike deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhanti
an8.36:4.4: dibbena āyunā, dibbena vaṇṇena, dibbena sukhena, dibbena yasena, dibbena ādhipateyyena, dibbehi rūpehi, dibbehi saddehi, dibbehi gandhehi, dibbehi rasehi, dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi.
an8.36:5.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:5.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:5.3: tatra bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā tāvatiṃse deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti
an8.36:6.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:6.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:6.3: tatra bhikkhave, suyāmo devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, yāme deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti.
an8.36:7.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:7.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:7.3: tatra bhikkhave santusito devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā tusite deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti.
an8.36:8.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:8.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā nimmāṇaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:8.3: tatra bhikkhave, sunimmito devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, nimmāṇaratī deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti.
an8.36:9.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:9.2: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā paranimmita vasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:9.3: tatra bhikkhave, vasavattī devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā, paranimmitavasavattī deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti
an8.36:9.4: dibbena āyunā, dibbena vaṇṇena, dibbena sukhena, dibbena yasena, dibbena ādhipateyyena, dibbehi rūpehi, dibbehi saddehi, dibbehi gandhehi,dibbehi rasehi, dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi.
